description: Add or improve logging, metrics, tracing, and alerts in an application following its existing stack (structured loggers, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing), so that failures and latency can be diagnosed without leaking personal data or secrets. Use when the user asks to add logging (including logging requests or request bodies to debug a problem), metrics, tracing, instrumentation, dashboards, health checks, or alerts, or to make a service easier to debug in production. Do not use for diagnosing a specific failure (use kit-debugging), for performance tuning (use kit-performance), or for configuring hosted monitoring vendors outside the repository.
